thread:
sam: hey team — noticed my year-to-date federal wages on the portal look ~ $18k higher than i expected. i was a 1099 contractor through EOR for Jan-Mar, then converted to full-time payroll on 2026-04-01. paystub shows the contractor invoices were also included as W-2 wages. can someone check?

 tara-payroll: yikes. can you DM the invoice numbers or paste them here? we'll pull the run history. did the EOR invoice go through payroll workflow or AP?

 sam: invoice IDs INV-9887 and INV-9921. i submitted them to olga@eor for contractor payout on 2026-03-15. attached screenshots.

 mike-peopleops: confirmed conversion paperwork signed 2026-04-01. onboarding records show prior contractor engagement flagged as external pay. looks like there may have been a duplicate payment path.

 olga-eor: checking our side — we recorded payouts for INV-9887 on 2026-03-19 (ACH to sam) and INV-9921 on 2026-03-26. EOR file shows no reversal.

 payroll-bot: Payroll run PR-2026-Q2-01 completed 2026-04-05 04:12 UTC. E-EMP-114 included gross earnings 2026-01..04 inclusive. Source fields: {PAY_SOURCE: PAYROLL, AP_SOURCE: AP_EOR}.

 tara-payroll: looks like AP feed and payroll run both ingested the contractor amounts when we converted the funding code. sample log excerpt: ```[2026-04-05T03:58:21Z] E-EMP-114 | AMT_INCL=18000 | SRC_LIST=[EOR_AP, PAYROLL] | FLAG=dup_merge_missing```

 lisa-finance: GL impact: federal withholding liability and employer tax accruals were overstated for the payroll run. need JE to reverse duplicate W-2 wages before year-end close. if W-2 already issued we'll need a W-2c. can payroll confirm whether W-2s are queued?

 tara-payroll: we haven't finalized W-2 staging for FY2026 yet; internal cutoff is 2026-12-10. good that this surfaced now. proposed steps: 1) confirm duplicate amounts and exact channels, 2) generate reversing JE for payroll gross + tax withholdings, 3) coordinate with EOR/AP to confirm contractor payments stay intact, 4) ensure final W-2 reflects only payroll wages, 5) document for sam for tax filing. opening ticket PAY-4607.

 olga-eor: AP confirms contractor payments were legitimate and should remain with EOR. we'll provide proof of payment to include in PAY-4607.

 tax-advisor: for sam: if a duplicate W-2 is corrected before calendar year end the W-2 should be fine; if not corrected, we'll need a W-2c and you may need to amend with IRS/STATE when filing. keep all contractor 1099 docs from EOR (they'll issue 1099-NEC to you).

 sam: thanks. i prefer payroll correct on their side and keep the EOR payments as-is. please let me know if i need to hold off filing taxes.

 tara-payroll: accepted. i've created PAY-4607 and assigned to payroll ops & finance. vendor/eng will patch the feed to prevent duplicate ingestion. ETA for reversal JE is 7 business days after vendor confirms fix. tagging lisa and olga.

 lisa-finance: i'll review JE once it's drafted. we may need a temporary suspense account for month-end until reconciliation completes.

 payroll-bot: PAY-4607 created 2026-04-06T09:12Z. SLA: vendor fix + JE draft due by 2026-04-15. off-cycle corrections window available.

 mike-peopleops: documenting conversion policy update: add a checkbox in the conversion checklist to confirm AP/EOR feeds are reconciled before payroll inclusion. i'll push a PR to the playbook.

 sam: appreciate the quick triage. pls cc me on PAY-4607 and any forms i need to sign.

 tara-payroll: will do — keeping this thread as the source. will update when JE posted or W-2 staging changed. :white_check_mark:
